batting.dismissal: st DH Yagnik b AL Menaria

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c J Botha b SK Warne

batting.name: R Sathish
batting.dismissal: st DH Yagnik b J Botha

balls.text: bang! Harbhajan's cynical tactic has had some reward. He finally connects with his pull and slams it over the deep midwicket
the short ball and Harbhajan misses the hook

Harbhajan backs away and swipes again, hitting the short ball towards deep square, but Harbhajan wanted the strike so he didn't complete the first run by several yards. That is a shocker. He just about crossed half the pitch and passed his partner and then turned back for the second. Completely intentional. So he completed 2/3rd of the first run and as much of the second.
Murtaza backs away to create room and drives the ball towards point
short ball again and Harbhajan pulls hard, but can't find the gap on the midwicket boundary
Harbhajan tries to pull, and he does. But can't place it past midwicket
driven from the crease towards cover
played from the crease towards point
Murtaza tries to play the big drive through the off side but misses
short ball outside off, Harbhajan slaps it to mid-off
driven off the front foot through extra cover

bowled him! Someone hits Malinga's stumps for a change. Malinga backed away towards leg to pull a short of a length ball. He exposed all three stumps, and Amit Singh gratefully hit the top off off and middle
played through cover off the back foot
pushed off the back foot towards cover
nudged off the pads towards midwicket

stumped! Mumbai are sliding towards a shocking total at the fortress. Sathish charged and heaved, trying to hit the ball far too hard without getting anywhere near it. He missed and the keeper had an easy stumping to effect
Harbhajan pulls the ball powerfully towards long-on

bowled him! Symonds went down on one knee to slog sweep and then tried to adjust and play a half-swat half-paddle, the ball pitched around off, came slowly off the pitch, beat the bat and pegged back off stump. That kept a touch low as well
Sathish baks away this time and slugs the ball through midwicket
Symonds backs away and hits the ball with a flat bat towards long off
Sathish backs away and hits a length ball limply towards mid-off
another short ball, this time Symonds stays in his crease and pulls towards deep square
pulled away! Symonds steps out to the short ball and swats it powerfully into the gap between deep midwicket and long-on
Sathish backs away towards leg and plays the ball towards long leg
loud appeal for lbw, Botha thinks it hit pad first perhaps. The batsman had played it to midwicket
Sathish comes forward and lunges to hit the ball in the air towards long off where if falls short of the fielder
Sathish gets going by cutting the ball through point

Pollard's struggle has ended. He moved a long way across his stumps to play the offbreak towards square leg, he missed and was hit plumb in front, Botha was so sure that he was celebrating before the umpire raised the finger
played behind square
played behind point for a single
a slower ball on a good length, Pollard defends towards the bowler
Symonds plays from his crease towards cover point
Pollard swivels and hits a length ball on the first bounce to deep square leg
Pollard charges, Trivedi bowls him a slower bouncer and beats the half-hearted swat
a length delivery doesn't bounce much, the line is straight and Symonds nudges of his pads behind square
Pollard moves across to glance the ball but misses and gets hit on the pad
played watchfully off the front foot towards cover, 4-0-13-1, another terrific spell from the magnificent Warne
Pollard goes deep into his crease and plays towards point

that's pretty terrific bowling! Warne tossed the ball up, inviting Pollard to hit him, Pollard obliged and swung hard, dragging his foot outside the crease, the ball dipped and turned a long way, beating the bat. The keeper had to collect the ball far to his right because it turned so much and by the time he took off the bails Pollard's back foot was just over the line, so close
flicked off the pads through midwicket
defended on the leg side
played towards backward point off the front foot
good length and very straight, Pollard defends towards the bowler
played off the back foot towards cover
Symonds gets hit on the thigh by a short of a length delivery that angles into him
Symonds cuts the length delivery outside off stump towards point
another short of a length ball down leg side
loud appeal for lbw, Watson's length is a touch fuller, Pollard tries to play across the line and gets hit high on the pad, the ball goes towards third man
Watson continues the short-ball barrage, this time it's a touch down leg side
defended back towards the bowler
Pollard scores his first runs of the tournament by flicking the ball off his pads through square
Warne pitches the ball around off, Pollard pushes forward to defend and gets beaten by considerable turn
Symonds comes forward and pushes the ball through midwicket
a bit too far down leg side this time, Symonds sweeps to fine leg
superb ball, draws Symonds forward with the flight, drifts and dips, pitches on middle and spins past the outside edge
Pollard tries to nudge on the leg side and fails to make proper contact, top over from Watson
Watson continues pinning the batsmen to their crease with his length, Pollard defends on the back foot
short of a length delivery, Symonds jumps back in his crease and plays on the off
another short ball, Watson is giving his former Queensland team-mate nothing, Symonds ducks
short ball, Symonds doesn't have to duck to let this pass him
short ball, the batsman ducks under it
caught at long-off! Sharma plays the lofted drive but doesn't place it high enough or wide enough to beat Johan Botha on the boundary, the Mumbai juggernaut is losing steam in Jaipur
Sharma sweeps, Warne drifts the ball towards leg, slows it up and beats the batsman, the ball hits Sharma's arm and then his face, which is protected by his helmet
driven towards Warne's right, he dives full length to field the ball
driven towards long off for a single
Symonds strides forward to a flighted delivery and defends
tossed up on middle stump, Sharma stays in his crease and drives through cover
tossed up outside off, pushed into the covers for a single
nudged off his pads towards square leg
caught and bowled! Rayudu gives Menaria the charge, the bowler sees him coming and shortens his length, the ball comes on rather slowly and Rayudu ends up tapping it back to the bowler
this time he cuts in front of point for a single
superbly placed, Sharma waits on his back foot, plays the ball extremely late and cuts it into the gap on the backward pint boundary
short and a bit wide outside off, the ball comes on to the bat slowly and Rayudu cuts towards deep point
dabbed off the back foot towards point
driven off the back foot towards long on
defended on the of side
Rayudu steps out and drives the ball flat and fast towards Warne's right, he dives full length and gets fingertips on the ball, terrific effort
Warne drifts the ball outside leg but doesn't get it to turn this time
skiddy delivery, punched off the back foot towards cover point
tossed up on leg and middle, played on the off side
driven of the back foot through cover
moves forward and taps the ball behind point for a single
driven back to the bowler
played towards deep backward square leg
nudged towards long-on but the ball is intercepted by the flying fielder from midwicket
tossed up outside off, driven off the front foot towards long off
driven down the ground towards long off once again
After four dots, Sharma pushes towards long-off and gets going
length ball just outside off, Sharma defends with a straight bat towards the off side
too full and straight, Sharma flicks but can't beat Taylor at square leg
loud shout for lbw after Sharma gets hit on the pad while he was caught on the crease, that was missing leg
Amit sends down a slower bouncer, forcing Rohit to drop his wrists and sway out of the way
played back to the bowler
pushed towards long-on for a single
Rohit moves back and punches the ball towards cover point
Rohit plays the ball towards cover
there won't be any of Tendulkar v Warne today! Menaria's got him! Tendulkar charged the bowler, Menaria tossed it up and slowed it down, Tendulkar swung hard and connected with nothing, easy stumping
played off the front foot towards cover
Rayudu changes, makes a bit of room, and launches the length ball flat over extra cover, the bounces once before going over the boundary
short of a length and straight, played off the back foot towards point
Tendulkar moves forward to push the ball to mid-on and sets off as soon as he makes contact
mis-timed on the leg side after attempting a powerful heave and they run a quick single, Rayudu had to hurry
Rayudu pushes forward and outside off an a short of a length ball, that might have taken an edge but fell short of the keeper
bowled him! Jacobs tried to hit the ball down the ground again, planting his foot forward and aiming for wide long-on, he missed and Amit hit middle stump
good length and straight, played from the crease towards mid-on
played off the pads through square leg
shot, Jacobs steps out once again, like he's tried to several times. This time he reaches the length ball and punches it with a straight bat, without a follow through, over the long-on boundary
full ball on middle stump, Tendulkar leans forward and clips it off his pads towards deep midwicket
played with soft hands on the off side for a single
Jacob comes down and tries to swing the length ball on the leg side, he misses and gets hit on the body
fullish length, Tendulkar times the cover drive well off the front foot but places it to the fielder
shorter length on middle and leg, Jacobs pulls towards long leg
pushed from the crease towards extra cover
the keeper stands up to the stumps and collects the ball outside off after Jacobs swings hard and misses again
Jacobs charges down and moves a touch towards off and swings hard, he misses but the umpire thinks the ball was too wide outside off
Amit replies with a terrific delivery that pitches on a length and seams away from the batsman, beating the edge
full and wide outside off, Jacobs reaches out for it and edges the drive over backward point to the boundary
the line is a bit too straight and Jacobs nudges off his pads towards wide mid-on
Jacobs tries to cut but misses outside off
cut off the back foot towards point
nudged through midwicket for a single
Tendulkar leans forward and drives the ball fluently through cover point, where Dravid dives over the ball to allow the boundary
width outside off stump, Jacobs cuts to point and the crowd begins to cheer, because Tendulkar gets the strike

dropped, Taylor swipes across the line, gets a top edge that goes over the keeper, Pollard runs towards it from behind point on the off side, gets both hands to it, and drops it, and Rajasthan celebrate
defended once again towards the bowler
good length and straight, defended on the leg side
left alone outside off stump
Menaria gets going by cutting a a ball that was slightly wide through point
bowled him! Botha stayed in his crease and tried to run a good length ball behind point, he missed and Munaf hit the top of off stump
length ball, flicked from middle stump off the back foot
full ball on middle stump, clipped towards wide mid-on
played towards mid-off
short of a length on leg stump, glanced off the hips towards fine leg
full again and Botha lifts it off his pads over midwicket and places it in the gap on the boundary
a full ball crashes into the batsman's pads after the attempted flick is unsuccessful, that was missing leg
full and straight, the batsman is ready, and he defends with a straight bat towards the bowler
the keeper hits direct at the batsman's end after the batsman bottom edges the ball over his stumps, but the single has already been stolen
full toss on the pads, clipped fluently towards deep square leg
short ball and Taylor pulls towards deep midwicket
wide down leg side, bowl that again says the umpire, well he didn't actually say it
the slower bouncer, and Taylor has to duck rather low to get under it
Botha jumps on to the back foot and defends on the off side, played with soft hands and he runs the single
a short ball, a long hop actually, and Taylor pulls towards deep midwicket
this one keeps low and beats the batsman and the keeper
so deft, so late, Botha opens the face to steer towards third man
Botha moves back and gets beaten outside off
Taylor waits in his crease and dabs the ball towards third man
fuller length outside off and Taylor leans forward to drive the ball superbly to the extra cover boundary, he only had to beat the fielder in the in field
played from the crease towards point
full toss around off, played into the covers
cut off the back foot towards cover point
played off the pads towards midwicket
defended on the front foot towards the off
Botha gets down on one knee and sweeps the ball from outside off towards deep square
width outside off stump, cut late by Taylor towards third man
blocked off the front foot towards the off
defended towards cover from the crease
full and straight, flicked off the pads through square leg
pushed on the front foot towards cover
played towards midwicket on the front foot
played off the back foot towards midwicket, the bowler gives chase
Malinga bowls a straight full toss, which Taylor pays towards the off side
full and swinging into the right-hander, Taylor defends on the leg side

caught behind! Malinga changed tactic and banged in the short ball, Watson tried to hook and seemed to edge it to the keeper, Jacobs moved to his left and took an easy catch. Watson isn't happy but that's probably because he's out and not because he didn't edge it. Looked like an edge
a yorker, and Watson watchfully plays it on the leg side
full again, Botha drives towards mid-of and runs the single
Botha won't! He moves forward and drives a full ball wide of the fielder at mid-off
this time he connects, down on one knee and the powerful slog sweep sends the ball racing along the ground towards the deep midwicket boundary
Watson backs away to make room and mis-hits it towards the bowler
Watson tries to play a powerful slog sweep against a straight ball and he misses, the ball bounces over middle stump
Watson strides forward and defends watchfully
driven on the front foot towards long off
played off the back foot on the leg side
Watson makes room and hits the length ball in the air and over the bowler's head
played towards cover from the crease
Watson drops the ball by his feet
played off the back foot past the bowler towards long-on
played towards deep square leg
that's a massive offbreak from Pollard and a massive-er appeal for lbw, that jagged back sharply from outside off and hit Botha on the thigh, too high
short ball outside off, cut with power to the man on the point boundary
played off the pads behind square
Watson moves back and cuts towards cover point
driven towards wide long-off and the batsman want two, the throw from the deep is wide at the bowler's end
Botha gets down on one knee and heaves the ball over the deep midwicket boundary with a powerful slog-sweep
Botha goes back and plays the ball towards the bowler
played behind point for a single
driven powerfully off the front foot towards long off where the fielder dives to his left to make the save. Well done Munaf
Botha loses balance after getting beaten on the cut
played from the crease towards point
Watson hits the ball hard towards mid-off on the front foot
good length on off stump, played off the front foot towards mid-off
cut off the back foot through point
this time he inside-edges it on the leg side
Botha goes right back and just about manages to hit the ball with the bottom of his bat, he'd have been plumb otherwise
good length just outside off, the batsman moves forward and defends on the off and runs the quick single before a sprightly Tendulkar can prevent it
Botha moves back and pushes the ball towards mid-on
Botha moves forward and plays across the line towards midwicket
defended on the front foot towards midwicket
played back to the bowler again
the ball is not coming on off this slow pitch, Watson drives into the ground towards the bowler
this one keeps a bit low and Watson hits it back to the bowler
Watson goes back and cuts the ball from his stumps towards point
driven from the crease to long off
Watson tries to run a good length ball towards third man and is beaten once again, the keeper's standing up by the way so Watson can't take a risk-free walk down the pitch
excellent length and line, giving Watson no hitting space, he plays towards the off side
Watson tries to cut a ball that is a touch too full and gets beaten
Dravid moves forward and is beaten by the slower ball, he ends up lunging for it and scooping it high in the air towards midwicket where Tendulkar settles under the catch
good length outside off, Dravid plays the ball towards cover point where Pollard doesn't stop the ball cleanly
good length and straight, played back to the bowler
Dravid backs away and forces the ball towards mid off to keep strike
short ball and Watson goes back to pull towards deep square leg
played off the back foot towards mid-off
moves his front foot out of the way and swats the ball towards wide mid-on
cut off the back foot towards point
flicked off the pads behind square
superb shot, Watson waits for that full ball and drives the ball powerfully past the bowler, it wasn't quite yorker length and Watson met it on the front foot
another attempted yorker that is actually a low full toss, Dravid pushes towards mid-off
another yorker, Dravid's ready and blocks
another yorker, full and straight, Rajasthan are under no pressure to score quickly so Dravid calmly defends towards the bowler
a searing delivery in the blockhole outside off, Dravid pushes towards cover point
Malinga unleashes a straight full toss, was looking for the yorker again, Dravid stays in his crease and plays towards square leg
defended solidly from the crease towards the bowler
good length and straight, Watson defends
defended on the off side
played on the leg side from the crease
shot! Watson moves his front foot slightly across, brings his bat down across his front pad, and drives the ball through wide mid-on
good length and straight, Watson moves back and defends on the leg side
played watchfully towards cover, Malinga's first over has been successfully negotiated by Rajasthan
played towards mid-off
Dravid jumps on the back foot to fend off a short ball towards point
the first yorker, but Watson jams his bat down and inside-edges it behind square
full ball on the pads, Watson stays on the back foot and flicks through square
length ball outside off stump, Watson stays in his crease and drives to point
